page_note: 本页为《2024 US Professional Services Partner Compensation Survey》第24页，左侧有一段说明文字，下方是一张按合伙人任期分三栏的横向分组条形图（2024 vs 2022），所有数值均直接标注在条上且无数值轴。

heading.title: Total cash compensation, by tenure as partner (%)

figures.source_line: Source: Heidrick & Struggles US professional services partner compensation survey, 2024, n=155 Source: Heidrick & Struggles US professional services partner compensation survey, 2022, n=192

components.evidence: two bars per row, dark 2024 above cyan 2022, in each of the three tenure panels
compensation bands sit on the left as rows; bars grow rightward from a common left edge
no ticks or gridlines anywhere; only printed numbers such as 26, 35, 45 read the bars
long bars carry the number inside their right end, e.g. `26`, `35`, `45`, `46`
short bars print the number to the right of the mark, e.g. `3`, `2`, `4`, `5`
three panels: `Less than 6 years`, `6–10 years`, `More than 10 years`, same rows repeated
each panel headed in bold above itself: `Less than 6 years`, `6–10 years`, `More than 10 years`
single legend `2024  2022` above the three panels governing all of them
legend swatches for 2024 and 2022 sit between the title line and the panels
row labels ($400,000 or less ... More than $3.00m) printed once at the left for all three panels
`Note: Numbers may not sum to 100%, because of rounding.` plus two `Source: Heidrick & Struggles...` lines
title ends `by tenure as partner (%)`; bars themselves carry no unit
seven long money-band row labels stacked down the left, e.g. `$401,000–$600,000`
legend row sits at far left, left of the first panel's column, above the row labels

difficulty_notes: 取值本身不难：42 个条全部印有数字，无需按刻度估读（也确实没有任何数值轴）。难点在寻址：一个值需要面板名（Less than 6 years / 6–10 years / More than 10 years）+ 行标签（7 个金额区间）+ 系列（2024 或 2022）三层键，共 42 个格子，而像 4 出现 5 次、16 出现 4 次、2 与 3 各出现多次，缺少任一层键就无法唯一定位。解析器通常把三个面板压成一张宽表或拆成三张无标题小表，面板名一旦掉出表体（它只是加粗文字，不是表头），值与标签的配对即失效。

suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段：数值标签位置按条长阈值自动切换（长条内右端、短条外右侧）
